# Abstract {.unnumbered .toc-black}

This work presents and documents the `quarto-cnam-thesis` Quarto extension, which enables
doctoral students at the Conservatoire national des arts et métiers ({{< acrs cnam >}}) to
write their thesis in Quarto Markdown and simultaneously produce a PDF compliant with the
2024-2025 institutional template (book class, pdflatex engine, PDF/A-1b compliance) and a
navigable HTML version. The thesis is organised in five chapters, each documenting a family
of features: document structure and formatting, figures and layout, equations and tables,
callouts and code blocks, and finally references, glossary, and collaborative annotations.
Most features are presented following a *code + output* principle: a Markdown code block
displays the exact syntax to use, immediately followed by the live rendering in the
document. This self-referential approach allows the document to serve both as a user guide
and a live demonstration of the template.

**Keywords:** Quarto, LaTeX, pdflatex, PDF/A, doctoral thesis, reproducible scientific
publishing, {{< acrs cnam >}}
:::
